input.source: completed SW0142 seed1 masked float16 spike cache and its shared 256-update warm binder
input.rows: first64 registered source1 TRAIN IDs in cache order
input.cached_spikes: actual emitted [B,4,1024,512] traces, float16 on disk; promoted to float32 by the production cache reader
input.warm_assignment: native32 P argmax and existing largest-hard-slot background rule

readouts.fragmentation: For each nonbackground hard P label, 4-neighbor component masses and (label mass - largest component)/label mass; aggregate by foreground patch mass.
readouts.boundary_energy: Mean squared RGB difference across the shared pixel seam for each adjacent native32 patch pair; only pairs whose two patches are visible in the cached SW0142 mask are retained.
readouts.descriptive_target: exp(-boundary_energy / s), where s is the mean retained RGB boundary energy over these same64 TRAIN rows. This is descriptive only, not an objective coefficient or calibration.

scope_limits: CPU-only, first64 rows, no GT, no optimizer step, no model update, no predictions.
The source spikes are float16 cached traces from the masked SW0142 input; no clean-input parity or gradient claim is made.
This association diagnostic does not establish a causal mechanism or justify a training recipe, threshold, or model-selection decision.
